summary: Custom Channels is an in-store audio/commercial-music platform combining licensed music curation, AI-powered audio messaging, and digital signage for multi-location restaurant brands.

Custom Channels partnered with loyalty platform Thanx (announced May 2026) to connect in-store audio messaging with loyalty data; Bubbakoo's Burritos reported a double-digit increase in loyalty sign-ups within the first month of running targeted audio promotions across its 100+ stores. (Scope note: Bubbakoo's Burritos result is a single named-customer example from a partner press release, not an independently audited or company-wide benchmark.)

Custom Channels launched a reimagined customer portal in August 2026 for managing music and messaging across multiple restaurant locations, and separately partnered with Steady Brand in September 2026 to expand music and media offerings.
